<!-- The page is built in the browser from home/gallery.json, which
home/build-data.lua writes before every render from each example's front
matter, home/examples.yml, and the examples' code. -->

```{ojs}
import {hero} from "./home/js/hero.js"
import {explorer} from "./home/js/explorer.js"
G = FileAttachment("home/gallery.json").json()
```

::: {.column-screen}
```{ojs}
hero(G, {onPath: () => X.showPath()})
```
:::

::: {.column-screen}
```{ojs}
X = explorer(G)
```

```{=html}
<div class="home-foot">
  <div>
    <h3>Ask for an example</h3>
    <p>Wondering how to build a network model in EpiModel that does something not covered here? <a href="https://github.com/EpiModel/EpiModel-Gallery/issues">Open an issue</a> describing it.</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h3>Contribute one</h3>
    <p>New examples are welcome. The <a href="about.html#contributing">About page</a> lists the files an example needs and how the tests run.</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h3>Run the code</h3>
    <p>Every page links its standalone <code>model.R</code> and <code>module-fx.R</code>. Clone the <a href="https://github.com/EpiModel/EpiModel-Gallery">repository</a> to run them all with <code>bash test.sh</code>.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
